entities.name: A7FI31 anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (333 aa) to reviewed Yersinia pseudotuberculosis UniProt A7FI31.
Catalyzes PRPP-dependent conversion of anthranilate to N-(5'-phosphoribosyl)-anthranilate (PRA); EC 2.4.2.18.
Annotated cytosolic; binds two Mg2+ ions per monomer and is a homodimer.
Participates in L-tryptophan biosynthesis from chorismate, step 2 of 5.

entities.name: L-tryptophan biosynthesis
observations: A7FI31 anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase is annotated at step 2 of 5 in L-tryptophan biosynthesis from chorismate.

entities.name: Anthranilate PRPP transfer
observations: Anthranilate + PRPP → N-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)anthranilate (PRA) + diphosphate; Rhea RHEA:11768, EC 2.4.2.18; Mg2+ dependent annotation.
